_about: How tokens become energy. Every number here is an assumption you can change; tracker/update.py reads this file. Prices are Anthropic's list prices in US dollars per million tokens (first-party API, October 2026). Cache writes cost 1.25 times fresh input and cache reads 0.1 times, on every model.
_anchor: One typical chatbot answer (about 1,000 tokens in and 500 out on a mid-sized model, here Claude Sonnet 5.5) is taken to use 0.3 Wh, the figure published estimates converge on (Epoch AI 2025: about 0.3 Wh for a typical GPT-4o query; Google 2025: 0.24 Wh for the median Gemini text prompt; OpenAI 2025: 0.34 Wh for the average ChatGPT query). The low and high ends allow for a factor of three either way, since no provider publishes per-token figures for Claude. Energy then scales with the list price of the tokens, used as a stand-in for the computing work behind them.

commute._about: My own yardstick: driving to SFU and back. 9.2 km each way in my 2008 Volvo XC70 (3.2 L petrol, AWD). Published combined figures for it run from 11.4 L/100 km (European test) to 13 L/100 km (North American estimate), 16 in town; 13 is used here, since the drive climbs Burnaby Mountain. Petrol holds about 8.9 kWh per litre (its lower heating value, about 32 MJ/L).
